source.notes: Scanned school examination paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Header printed on the paper: 'Biology/Class VII/First Assessment/Session-22-23/ F.M-50'; examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed session 22-23 (the file name also carries the dates 060323-150323). No school name and no time allowed are printed. Section A [20 marks], Section B [30 Marks]; all questions compulsory. Where a bracketed mark covers a group of items (e.g. Question 1 [5] over five MCQs, Question 5 A [3] over three terms), each item gets an equal share (marksSource SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS). The page is slightly skewed, so the right-hand marks column of Question 6 does not line up exactly with the lines: the printed brackets [2], [2], [2], [4] were read as A, B(i), B(ii), C, which is the only reading that gives Question 6 ten marks and Section B 30 marks. Page 3 is cut off at the left edge: the 'Question 7' heading and the labels 'A.' and 'B.' of its first two parts are not visible; the number and labels were inferred from the sequence (Question 6 ends on page 2, and part C is labelled on page 3). Student ticks and pen underlining on the scan were ignored. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
